notes: True homograph of H7786 (שׂוּר, "rule") -- see its notes for the full homonym picture (including two further unadded homonyms, H7787 and H7789). Both roots are new in this same batch; assigned שור² (higher Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention.
Single attestation in the entire Hebrew Bible (Isa.57.9, "and thou wentest to the king with ointment").
